original_test_intent: Verify that TEMP_AMBIENT name, description, reading, units and state agree with the approved physical ambient-sensor definition across IB SDR, OOB SDR, IB Sensor List, OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: Prove IB and OOB address the same target, collect complete unfiltered SDR and Sensor lists on both paths within a bounded interval, capture the full protected Web row and refresh context, normalize the five schemas, compare identity/description/value/units/state/timestamp to the SPEC and preserve raw evidence without clearing logs or mutating SDR or thermal controls.
manual_activity: A platform reviewer approves the ambient sensor's physical location and SPEC, verifies IB/OOB same-target proof, visually confirms the Web row and adjudicates any bounded cross-view difference.
required_inputs: Approved TEMP_AMBIENT physical location and SPEC
Units, health, threshold and range rules
Reviewed private Script revision or independent equivalent
safety_requirements: Do not change thresholds, fans, power or configuration
Keep credentials out of command history and evidence
Reject stale, missing or duplicate entries
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete IB and OOB SDR lists
Collect complete IB and OOB Sensor lists
Normalize name, description, reading, units, status, thresholds and timestamps
Apply approved tolerance and SPEC rules
engineer_actions: Approve physical ambient identity, SPEC and field mapping
Approve capture window and numeric tolerance
Resolve path, schema, timestamp or value mismatch

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: One OOB `sensor get` and a first-100-line SDR sample cover neither complete IB/OOB lists nor the Web view and cannot prove the required five-way name/description/reading agreement.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe runners to capture full unfiltered SDR and Sensor lists through both verified paths, then capture the authoritative Web row; normalize all five views inside the approved time window.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor and Web coverage remain. The 3/3-minute estimate is retained as source metadata, but generic log clearing, grep-only evidence and truncation are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create one evidence bundle containing same-target proof, full raw outputs, normalized TEMP_AMBIENT fields and Web capture, all timestamped within the approved refresh window.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces grep/visual juxtaposition with complete structured capture, explicit field normalization and temporal tolerance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single correct OOB value cannot detect repository divergence, IB targeting error, Web staleness or description/unit mismatch.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readings may legitimately drift between sequential captures; only the approved time/value tolerance may distinguish normal ambient change from cross-view disagreement.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define physical ambient location, canonical description, field mappings, units, range, refresh window and allowed cross-view delta. A private Script reference is not executable authority until its pinned revision is reviewed.
expected_evidence: SUT/BMC/firmware identity and IB/OOB/Web same-target proof
Ambient sensor physical location and approved SPEC revision
Complete raw/decoded IB and OOB SDR lists
Complete raw/decoded IB and OOB Sensor lists
Protected full Web row with filter/pagination/refresh context
Five-view normalized field/timestamp comparison with approved tolerance
Credential-redaction, no-mutation/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and three criteria coherently require the same ambient sensor across five views. Generic log clearing and DeepSeek's incomplete collection are method defects, not competing source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Same-target mapping, parsers, UI access and ambient SPEC are identifiable package inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if any required view or physical/field mapping cannot be obtained after the normal package request.

review_improvement: Restores all five source-required views and prevents one OOB command, a truncated list or a similarly named inlet sensor from standing in for cross-interface ambient consistency.
independent_technical_reasoning: IB and OOB can reach different management contexts, while SDR, Sensor List and Web layers may cache or normalize a reading differently. Ambient temperature also changes continuously. A defensible comparison therefore needs same-target proof, complete source sets, canonical physical identity and a bounded temporal/value tolerance rather than literal output equality or one command's success.
